ExpressionSetDefinition.description: Decides whether a permit may be issued: threading only for people with no other license, booth rental only with a current operator and salon license, and a temporary permit applied for 30 days ahead and renewed once at most.
ExpressionSetDefinition.label: Eligibility Permit

versions.description: Decides whether a permit may be issued: threading only for people with no other license, booth rental only with a current operator and salon license, and a temporary permit applied for 30 days ahead and renewed once at most.
versions.label: Eligibility Permit V1

assignment.expression: PermitType != "Temporary Permit" || IsRenewal || (NOT(ISBLANK(EventStartDate)) && EventStartDate >= ApplicationDate + AdvanceNoticeDays)

steps.description: A new temporary permit was applied for far enough ahead of the event.
steps.label: Set Is Applied In Time
steps.name: SetIsAppliedInTime

assignment.expression: PermitType != "Temporary Permit" || NOT(IsRenewal) || ISBLANK(PriorRenewalCount) || PriorRenewalCount < MaxTemporaryRenewals

steps.description: A temporary permit renewal is within the limit.
steps.label: Set Can Renew
steps.name: SetCanRenew

assignment.expression: IF(PermitType == "Threading Permit", NOT(HoldsOtherLicense), IF(PermitType == "Booth Rental Permit", HasCurrentOperatorLicense && HasCurrentSalonLicense, true)) && IsAppliedInTime && CanRenew

steps.description: All conditions for this permit are met.
steps.label: Set Is Eligible
steps.name: SetIsEligible

variables.description: The permit applied for: Threading Permit, Booth Rental Permit or Temporary Permit.

variables.description: True when the applicant holds any current license.

variables.description: True when the applicant holds a current cosmetologist license.

variables.description: Temporary permits: when the event starts.
variables.name: EventStartDate

variables.description: True when this renews an existing permit.
variables.name: IsRenewal

variables.description: Times the permit has been renewed before.
variables.name: PriorRenewalCount

variables.description: Days ahead of the event a temporary permit must be applied for.
variables.name: AdvanceNoticeDays

variables.description: Times a temporary permit can be renewed.
variables.name: MaxTemporaryRenewals

variables.description: A new temporary permit was applied for far enough ahead of the event.
variables.name: IsAppliedInTime

variables.description: A temporary permit renewal is within the limit.
variables.name: CanRenew

variables.description: All conditions for this permit are met.
variables.name: IsEligible
